Metadata.description: Documentation for BetterCmdTab, a faster and configurable Command-Tab switcher for macOS.

displayTiming.title: Display & timing
displayTiming.blurb: Where the panel opens and how quickly it reacts.

layout.title: Layout
layout.blurb: Which layout the switcher uses and how big it is.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.blurb: Colour, blur, corners, typography and preview capture for the panel.

contents.title: Contents
contents.blurb: Which apps and windows the switcher lists, in what order, and how it jumps to the one you pick.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.blurb: How browser and native tabs appear in the list.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.blurb: What happens while the shortcut is held, and how stepping works.

mouseHover.title: Mouse & hover
mouseHover.blurb: Pointer selection and the inline action buttons.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.blurb: The key combinations themselves are recorded outside this file. Scoped shortcuts and per-shortcut overrides are documented on their own pages.

feedbackMenuBar.title: Feedback & menu bar
feedbackMenuBar.blurb: Sound, haptics, the menu-bar icon and screen-sharing privacy.

trackpadSwipe.title: Trackpad swipe
trackpadSwipe.blurb: The three-finger trackpad gesture and how it behaves. Off by default; turn it on under Shortcuts › Trackpad swipe. These can change or disappear between releases.

legacy.title: Legacy
legacy.blurb: Superseded keys — always set the replacement named in the description instead. Only panelSize is migrated and then deleted; currentSpaceOnly, scopedShortcutScopes, experimentalBrowserTabMRU, experimentalInstantSpaceSwitch, experimentalBrowserTabPreviews and experimentalLivePreviews are still written on every change so older builds reading the same file stay consistent, so expect to see them; excludedBundleIDs and experimentalUnreadBadges are read as fallbacks at launch only and are never removed.
